results.content: The unreachable concluding tribe of India –The Sentinelese _____________________________________________ ANKITA GHOSH SEMESTER-6 GEOGRAPHY DEPARTMENT GOKHALE MEMORIALGIRLS’ COLLEGE JUNE,2025 ABSTRACT : An overview of the set of circumstances under which the uncontacted indigenous people of Sentinel Island survive .Their habitat ,economy has always been an effective part of research’s research ,however for the very fact of unavailability of more precise way of communicating and enforcing to the very location where the Sentinelese live ,with enormous protected shield , their island has always been an difficult place for the outsiders to reach , however under certain protocols it has been possible for some exceptional human beings to get the knowledge about the habitat of these indigenous people .in accordance to their research and perspective and definitely the handsome use of technology in taking satellite image a lot of information has been gained on the basis of which a very well synopsis can be effectively drawn on the way of life how these indigenous tribe ,Sentinelese survive .
